page_note: Page is heavily damaged (72.7%) but the surviving content is dominantly cosmological substrate: a teaching about how 'roots' (of Sin, of abortions, of stars/zodiac) were bound into trees and flesh, with men whose souls ascend not bound to the wheel. The first half (segs 0-14) is dense cosmic-process teaching. The middle (15-28) is a disciple recap-and-question unit — the recap reproduces substrate enumeration ('the first is...', 'the third is...') wrapped in 'we beseech you' frame, then poses a new substantive question ('which exceeds his fellow with more life'). The final unit (29-32) is the Illuminator's reply, now fragmentary. Editorial fatigue score reflects increased Q&A frame in the second half, but the substantive cosmological content embedded in those questions is substratic.
